notes.title: 1.3 Patch Notes | Season 1, Chapter 3
notes.notes:
New Battle Pass: Season 1, Chapter 3
Unlock new rewards in the third Season 1 mini Battle Pass, including: -- 3 exclusive character skins -- 10 exclusive weapon skins -- An exclusive portal skin -- Multiple emotes, sprays, charms, player card banners, and player card titles -- 500 Splitcoin + 60 Proelium

The Premium Battle Pass will cost 500 Splitcoin (roughly $4.99 USD).

As a reminder, your Battle Pass tokens are not reset between Chapters. If you didn’t complete the Chapter 1 or 2 Battle Passes yet, you’ll still be able to unlock that content over the rest of the season.
The Lab
New customizable lights: Point Light and Spotlight

Dev Note: More to come with skylight options soon.

New gamepad transform scheme for rotation, location and scale.

New customization options for weapon pads 

Dev Note: The tech developed for this will serve as a foundation for other map creator features down the line.
Bugfixes
Fixed a bug where marquee selection wouldn't consider object groups

Fixed a bug where scaling an object wouldn't preserve the expected ratio if scaled from an axis

Fixed a bug where groups, prefabs and multi-selections would break a part on rotation/translation

Fixed a bug where the catalog text prompt would reset focus after searching an object
Known Issues
Marquee selection is too sensitive.

Spectator mode doesn't currently work in map creator.

Players are sometimes not able to open their creations.

Desync issue where objects disappear present when players edit a map in multiplayer.

There are some focus issues present when using a gamepad.

notes.title: Splitgate 2 Hotfix - 7/23/2025

Challenge System

Dev Note: We will be auto-completing Weekly Challenges for Weeks 1-7 for all players to ensure that those who encountered issues can complete their Battle Pass as expected. notes.title: Community Update #2 | 7/18/25
notes.notes:
Hey Splitfam, welcome to our first Community Update where each week we’ll be recapping news you may have missed, highlighting your creations, and letting you know about upcoming community events. Let’s get right to it.


[hr][/hr]What’s New?[previewyoutube="QkLcOfOM7vw;full"][/previewyoutube]
In our third Splitgate Weekly video, our Lead Game Designer Darek shared a preview of some upcoming balance changes as well as some perspective on his approach to balance in Splitgate 2. Make sure to share your own takes on game balance in the comments after hearing from him. Our team is still heads-down on a long list of fixes and improvements which you’ll be hearing more about soon.


We’re also continuing our regular player surveys and would greatly appreciate you taking the time to complete this week’s SG2 survey. It won’t take long, we promise.


[hr][/hr]Community Map Highlights

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110560/97cc549e77e97be73dd52235bcfc0be2a809e5b8.jpg"]
Club Silo by Ahayayeeti
Code: mmv-jrr-nz2

Get ready to show off your moves in this incredible remake of Club Silo from Splitgate 1. The portal party never stops over here!


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110560/45b2bad1eaf18aa5da2423f2cb248fadc999622b.jpg"]
Urban Flora by Je11y_thebro
Code: wk0-2qg-y3t


This space-themed urban garden from Je11y has clearly been tended with care. Don’t let the beautiful architecture and greenery fool you though, this is a chaotic battlefield that will put your portalling to the test.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110560/e30387780db30a794bcbf170e2d204e2f8ca1106.png"]Surf Slide by DubbleA302 
Code: in3-gwv-vmx


We mentioned recently that ice is now appropriately slippery across custom maps from the Lab, and DoubleA302 wasted no time taking advantage of that. Movement fans should definitely check this one out, just make sure to bundle up first.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110560/90efc6f5d6ef982d2d91e36f7f1843ff5142f501.jpg"]
Whack-A-Mole by Jangutu 
Code: sd5-rpj-uai


Looking to play something truly outside of the box? Jangutu has you covered and the setup is simple: grab a Deadbolt and tell your friends to start jumping. This is surely the pinnacle of aim training, no question.


Are you a certified Lab Rat with a creation worth showing off? Tell us about it through this form so we can take a look for future weeks!


[hr][/hr]MVP Spotlight

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110560/2eeae6f871d1ee167cfc95573ad13ec38578907b.jpg"]

This week we’re spotlighting our MVP OmnicientWolf and asked him a few questions about him and his content!


Q: How did you first get into Splitgate?

I first got into Splitgate during the peak period where you had to often wait 3 hours in a login queue to get in due to the influx of players wanting to get in!  As a Halo fan, the idea of “Halo with portals” attracted me, and then once I started getting the hang of the portals, I was hooked!


Q: How would you describe the content you make?

I mostly stream and create content around Splitgate 2 gameplay, whether that be messing around in socials or getting sweaty in ranked.  That being said, I also dabble in educational content, especially if I have a question that I’m trying to get to the bottom of myself!  I’m a strong believer in sharing your knowledge with people, so if that’s something that I can do, then hey, sign me up.


Q: What modes do you play most often?

I’m definitely a 4v4 guy first and foremost.  I enjoy both social and ranked arena modes, so it really depends on what I’m feeling and who’s playing with me at the time.  In terms of specific playlist modes, I’ve always been a Team Deathmatch kind of guy, although I do enjoy Hot Zone quite a bit!


Q: Where can people find you to check out your content?

My most active platforms are Twitch and Twitter (or X, if you will).

Currently, I stream 3 days a week, Tuesdays – Wednesdays – Thursdays starting at 9 PM ET.


Q: Is there any content you’ve made that you’d like to highlight?
[previewyoutube="kx5sKIg6SLw;full"][/previewyoutube]
One of my first videos on Splitgate 2 was “3 Beginner Tips in 3 Minutes for Splitgate 2”


https://x.com/Splitgate/status/1943009005368152498

One of my funnier posts is when the 1/200 chance to fart in-game had me chuckling, as featured on the Splitgate 2 socials.

https://x.com/OmnicientWolf/status/1942644859485184281

And another one is showing off the ability to shoot the splitball in Splitgate 2


Q: Anything else you'd like to say to the community?

I don’t think Arena Shooters get enough love in today’s day and age, so I do hope that the community can rally together and help shape Splitgate 2 to be the best that it can be.


[hr][/hr]Community Events
Space Man In-Game Event (7/18-7/28)
Check out the new Rapid Royale Zero G mode featuring Battle Royale combat with low gravity, Mythic weapons skins, and more! Unlock exclusive rewards by playing any game mode until the event ends.
Play Together (7/18)
Interested in playing some Takedown with devs instead of hunting them down? Head over to our Discord server between 1:00 - 5:00 PM PT today to compete for your chance to win Splitcoin prizes.


GLHF and we'll see you back next week!

notes.title: Community Update #1 | 7/11/25
notes.notes:
Hey Splitfam, welcome to our first Community Update where each week we’ll be recapping news you may have missed, highlighting your creations, and letting you know about upcoming community events. Let’s get right to it.


[hr][/hr]What’s New?
Our Season 1 Chapter 2 update arrived with Ranked, Mastery Challenges, improvements to the Lab, and more. Check out the patch notes here if you missed them.


[previewyoutube="jsCnarFF-bo;full"][/previewyoutube]
In our second Splitgate Weekly video, our co-founders Ian and Nick shared more information about what we’re working on and the team’s priorities for fixing the game.


We’re doing more to quantify your feelings on the game and make sure we’re moving in the right direction. If you haven’t done so already, consider filling out this week’s SG2 survey.


[hr][/hr]Community Maps Spotlight

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110560/d3cbd1466ba166f914a7db1568719ef2edb28723.jpg"]
Celerity by Code Phoenix
Code: my5-yne-imc


With creative launch pad positioning and great portal placement, Celerity is an absolute blast to fly through at top speeds. Takedown fans should definitely add this one to their rotation.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110560/0215250507451ef97fccdc6914bd6b3f966c3bc7.jpg"]
Atlantis SG1 Remake by ahayayeetu
Code: op3-ogs-aqr


Feeling nostalgic for some undersea action? Dive into this awesome remake of an SG1 classic. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110560/f037573f96588865f05516998461c677e8641abc.jpg"]Don’t Fall / Only Up / Parkour by TTV:DjTyrannosaurusflex 
Code: t0o-2fj-3ig


If you think you’ve mastered movement in Splitgate 2, it might be time to put your skills to the test in this wild parkour map. Be warned: you might end up testing your endurance more than anything else.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110560/19c9ac9b633bc7f46ffea33c8e74e0c38b7be69b.jpg"]
Krusty Krab by AceBoogieJP
Code: 91g-u2y-tep


If you’ve ever wanted to live out your fry cook fantasies, we may have found the secret formula you’ve been looking for. Big Head Snipers on this map is a personal favorite over here.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110560/899d5aa372967e1733b7a7a06f3e810f89dbf8e1.jpg"]

Interested in making your own unique maps in the Lab? There’s never been a better time with the recent introduction of Mirroring options, circular portal walls, the new Sandbox building set, the new Glacier biome set, and much more! 

Once your custom creation is ready to play, tell us about it through this form and you might see it featured in a future Community Update.


[hr][/hr]Splitgate MVP Highlights

Our Splitgate MVPs are always creating great content and this week was no exception.
[previewyoutube="d9Lb1YiGjAI;full"][/previewyoutube][previewyoutube="WvRha8Toyn8;full"][/previewyoutube]
Need some help getting your loadouts in order before starting the Ranked grind? Mikaveli and MayorReynoldsTV have you covered.

[previewyoutube="8lM4n9qlQ9E;full"][/previewyoutube]
Already have your gear in order and just want to watch some great Ranked matches instead? Check out Staycation’s latest video for a preview of what to expect.


[hr][/hr]Community Events
4th of July (7/4 - 7/18)

The fireworks are still flying! You can unlock unique in-game rewards for free through next Friday by playing any mode or taking out enemies with the FUBAR power weapon.

Hunt The Devs (7/11)

Keep an eye out for aces with disco ball heads in Arena Quick Play! Our devs are going to be queueing up between 1:00 - 5:00 PM PT today, and killing them will earn you one of three exclusive Dev Killer skins.

Play Together (7/18)

Interested in playing with devs instead of hunting them down? Head over to our Discord server between 1:00 - 5:00 PM PT next Friday to compete for your chance to win Splitcoin prizes. We’ll be playing our next featured game mode together and we promise it’s out of this world.
[hr][/hr]
As always, thank you for playing and for sharing your feedback with our team. We’ll be back with another hotfix next week and will have a lot more to share with you all very soon.

GLHF this weekend!

Battle Royale
Added a “Last Man Standing” announcement which plays when you’re the only one alive on your team

Added a new Point of Interest to Glacier

Added invisible walls around the outer bounds of each biome to prevent flying out of bounds
Arena
Added the ability to rejoin a match in progress after leaving or being disconnected

Reduced the number of rounds in Arena Quickplay matches from 5 to 3

Ranked Arena will remain 5 rounds with Sudden Death

Added and adjusted a number of portal walls on Bypass
Balance Changes
(Aeros) Rush Ability

Now also grants immunity from debuffs, such as stuns or slows, while the ability is active

(Meridian) Phasma SMG 

Reduced the speed at which shots grow by 50% 

Reduced the maximum size of shots by 20%

Dev Note: Because the Phasma is not a hitscan weapon, its projectiles grow as they travel. These changes make it slightly harder to hit shots at longer ranges without impacting the weapon’s performance at close-range or overall damage
The Lab
Added Mirroring options in the Context Menu

Added new Sandbox building set to the Catalog

Added new Glacier biome set to the Catalog

Added Circular Portal Walls to the Catalog

Adjusted maximum launch distance on Portal Walls from 3,500 to 10,000

Added preview popup windows for Prefabs

Updated some icons used for the Gameplay Volumes

Improved Portal Wall Validation to prevent more false positives

Fixed missing collision on Simulation Portal Cube 8x8

Added King of the Hill zones to all base canvases

Adjusted FlatEarth canvas barrier markers around the map to be better merged into the ground

Lowered default kill boundary on the WetOcean canvas to -6 meters to prevent objectives from resetting when touching the water

Added simple underwater post processing and audio effect

Fixed grouped/prefabbed objects from breaking when transforming

Fixed search functionality in the Prefabs tab

Improved controller navigation in several areas of the UI

Fixed various bugs with the UI, thumbnails, and displayed text
Bug Fixes & Improvements
Fixed an issue in Arena where a tied round would display as a win, despite not counting towards the number of rounds won

Fixed a visual bug in Firecracker that could cause the bomb indicator to appear over the heads of multiple teammates

Improved performance and reduced reduced hitching in Battle Royale

Improved the quality of Global Illumination in Battle Royale

Improved performance and lighting for all dynamic and distant objects like item pickups, players, and chest in Battle Royale and Onslaught

Fixed an issue where graphical artifacts could appear when swapping weapons

Improved the visual quality and rendering performance of items in the Store

Ice on Custom Maps is now slippery

Fixed a variety of graphics crashes

notes.title: Splitgate 2 Hotfix - 6/25/2025
notes.notes:
Servers will unavailable from 9:00 PM to 11:00 PM Pacific Time while we deploy this week's hotfix.    

Follow @SplitgateStatus or check the Server Status channel of our Discord for live updates.


Balance Changes:
(Sabrask) Smart Wall Ability

The front side of the Wall now blocks shots from enemies and allies

The back side of the Wall can now be shot through by enemies and allies
Battle Royale:
Long pre-game timers (1:30) will occur less often, primarily in cases where players are taking longer than expected to load into the match

Killing an enemy now only reveals their teammates on the radar instead of providing a “wallhack” effect

Friendly pings are now only visible in the world if you’re in the same biome as the ping

Improved server performance, especially for players with high latency

Improved load times, especially for players on lower-end hardware

Improved the appearance of far-away environments
Other Bug Fixes:
Fixed an issue that could cause projectiles to have the incorrect size on clients

Fixed an issue causing exclamation points to appear incorrectly in certain parts of the UI and become impossible to clear

Fixed an issue that occasionally causes players to lose momentum mid-air when exiting a launch portal

Fixed several issues that could result in players getting stuck inside portal walls

Fixed a bug that occasionally caused players to not appear in the pre-game lobby

Fixed several issues causing visual effects to render incorrectly when viewed through a portal

Fixed several small issues with lighting in certain areas

Lobbies created for The Lab are now set to private by default

Improved performance across many areas of the game



Ranked, Weapon Mastery Skins, and much more will be arriving next Thursday! Stay tuned. 

Report a Bug Share Feedback

notes.title: Splitgate 2 Hotfix - 6/17/2025
notes.notes:
In a few hours there will be a short downtime while this hotfix is deployed to all platforms.


Balance Changes:
ALL Assault Rifles

OLD Damage Dropoff Ranges: 0, 3000, 4500, 6000, 7500, 9000

NEW Damage Dropoff Ranges: 0, 2500, 3750, 5000, 6250, 7500

\[Power Weapon] Gravitas Shotgun

Increased ammo cost per primary shot from 1 to 2

Note: The cost of the secondary fire is still 1

\[Aeros] Cadence Carbine

Decreased damage from 26 to 25

Increased fire rate by 3%

\[Meridian] Hyperline Carbine

Decreased base damage from 23 to 20

Decreased headshot damage from 31 to 30

\[Sabrask] Proximity Mine Equipment

No longer knocks back enemies hit by the explosion
Battle Royale:
Reduced the chance of an Event triggering each round from 30% to 22.5%

Reduced the “Kill Mark” duration from 3s to 2s

Note: Further changes are being made to this reveal in our next hotfix.

Added a “Can’t Interact” sound effect when you try to loot an item that you don’t have inventory space for

Fixed an issue that prevented the “Play Again” and “Main Menu” buttons from appearing after your team was eliminated

Fixed an issue with Legendary items playing the incorrect sound effects when looted

Fixed an issue where drop music ended early when detaching from the drop leader

Fixed an issue that prevented players from pinging with the comms wheel while in the Splitblimp

Fixed a bug that caused performance issues for players with a large number of in-game friends

Fixed a visual bug with Nanoswarm skins that caused graphical artifacts during the pre-game

Fixed a bug that prevented equipping Nanoswarm skin upgrades for the Helios Pistol

Fixed UI and Portal Wall visual bugs in game modes which have portals disabled

Fixed an issue with advanced options getting stuck when leaving a custom match



More updates arriving soon!

notes.title: Splitgate 2 Beta Hotfix 1 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
We have pushed a hotfix to steam with console updates coming this week. The update contains the following:


 Fixed Frontier shadows on low/medium shadow quality. Frontier has been added back to Arena Quickplay
 General client crash fixes and stability improvements, including crash when saving maps in The Lab after grouping and ungrouping actors
 Fixed issue where ammo reserves would not be dropped into weapon pickups on death
 Fixed Big Grey Wall at the back of Drought
 Minor server optimizations


NOTE: this may reset your loadout configurations to help fix certain players who became corrupted during the server outages. No one has lost any items.

notes.title: Splitgate 2's first gameplay is here, and yep, adding classes changes everything
notes.notes:
first look at Splitgate 2's gameplay shows off how the idea of an arena shooter, but with portals, is still just as wild and interesting a concept as when we first saw it. The 4.5 minute gameplay reveal features a few skilled streamers as they pour over Splitgate 2's combat, what sets it apart from the original Splitgate, and its three new classes—called factions...
                Read more.
